svg.desc: Hallucination: driftbench 71 of 72, other 36 of 72. Faithfulness: driftbench 71 of 72, other 36 of 72. Turn relevancy: driftbench 65 of 72, other 36 of 72. Completeness: driftbench 70 of 72, other 46 of 72. Role adherence: driftbench 72 of 72, other 63 of 72. DAG, one node: driftbench 65 of 72, other 65 of 72. Task completion: driftbench 72 of 72, other 72 of 72. Knowledge retention: driftbench 68 of 72, other 69 of 72. G-Eval, strict: driftbench 65 of 72, other 70 of 72. LLM rubric: driftbench 71 of 72, other 69 of 72. Personal data: driftbench 72 of 72, other 71 of 72. Goal success: driftbench 72 of 72, other 71 of 72. Factuality: driftbench 70 of 72, other 70 of 72. Reference correctness: driftbench 116 of 120, other 115 of 120. Grader panel: driftbench 59 of 60, other 59 of 60. Model-graded QA: driftbench 48 of 60, other 57 of 60. Model-graded fact: driftbench 48 of 60, other 59 of 60. Panel, borderline: driftbench 49 of 60, other 60 of 60.
